scope: read-only official NAVSIM source semantics; no dataset or execution access

source_findings.finding: filter_scenes reads each log pickle, splits its frame list into scene windows, selects the center-frame token and keys each filtered scene by that token
get_tokens_list_per_log groups filtered-scene tokens under the source-row log_name
SceneMetadata declares log_name, scene_token and initial_token as separate fields and loads them from separate source-row keys

controller_interpretation.reason: the official source represents scene_token and log_name separately and derives filtered-scene identity from a frame token; it provides no identity rule equating scene_token with log_name
controller_interpretation.required_future_evidence: a content-addressed exact-R1 mapping row for every accepted token containing token, segmented_log_name and source scene_token, with unique-set counts and hashes recomputed per official partition and complete timestamp-vehicle session
controller_interpretation.requirements_update_rule: do not revise or populate the frozen scene-token expectations until that exact mapping is controller-accepted and independently replayed

limitations: the official source check does not identify which exact NAVSIM checkout produced the accepted R1 ledger
the source check does not read the R1 metadata rows and therefore does not establish R1 scene-token cardinality or membership
the accepted R1 162-row session ledger contains log IDs and frame tokens but no independent scene_token field
no Failure-Patch selection evidence is supplied
